
<title> Client/Daemon Message Protocol </title>


<table border=1 cellpadding=5>
<tr><th>Message Type<th>Payload<th>Reply Payload
<tr><td>ATTACH<td>
  *  storage system,
  *  account name,
  *  container name,
  *  container alias,
  *  authentication string.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message.

<tr><td>DETACH<td>
  *  container alias<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message.

<tr><td>VTAB<td>
  *  virtual table name ("bcv_database" or "bcv_container"),
  *  filter string.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message,
  *  table data.

<tr><td>RESOLVE<td>
  *  container alias.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  storage system,
  *  account name,
  *  container name.

<tr><td>POLL<td>
  *  container name,
  *  authentication string.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message.

<tr><td>PIN<td>
  *  container name,
  *  database name,
  *  flag (pin or unpin),
  *  authentication string.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message.

<tr><td>HELLO<td>
  *  container name,
  *  database name.<td>

  *  database page size,
  *  system block size.
  *  storage system,
  *  account name,
  *  container name.

<tr><td>READ<td>
  *  authentication string,
  *  required block number,
  *  MRU list.<td>

  *  error code,
  *  error message,
  *  block to cache entry mapping.

<tr><td>END<td>
  *  MRU list.
<td> <i>No reply message</i>


</table>
